subject.title: fix: respect local Crabbox provider preferences

question: Should a developer’s user-level Crabbox provider persistently override OpenClaw’s repository Blacksmith Testbox default for ordinary trusted validation?
rationale: The root policy currently makes Testbox the trusted default, while this PR proposes operator-selected local providers; implementation cannot safely choose between those product policies.

options.title: Preserve the Testbox default
options.body: Keep repository policy unchanged and require explicit `--provider` or `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` when an operator wants another eligible backend.

options.title: Sponsor persistent local preference
options.body: Approve user-level preference above the repository default and implement a clearly higher-precedence Crabbox or OpenClaw contract with upgrade and proof coverage.

recommendation.title: Preserve the Testbox default
recommendation.body: Keep repository policy unchanged and require explicit `--provider` or `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` when an operator wants another eligible backend.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main provenance and recent ownership of the repository policy and imported Crabbox tooling make this the best available product-direction routing candidate.
